name: 019_pullback_uptrend_long_tf240
hypothesis: Every long idea in this project so far has paid up at a breakout, and R1.0 showed the only measured long edge in it - 005's long leg, gross +0.31 R - came from a session range break. This idea tests the other way to get long exposure: in an established uptrend, price dips to the fast EMA and closes back above it, where the counterparty is the seller who is late to a rising market and is selling into a dip that trend-following money wants. The dip is where size is available, rather than where the breakout crowd pays up, so the entry should be cheaper in R terms even if it fills less often. Direction is long because the long side is the only one that has ever shown a gross edge on this market (Exp 015). [Timeframe variant of 019_pullback_uptrend_long, 15m -> 240m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x16, pct stop x4.000.]
